summary: Build HR metrics, turnover analysis, and Power BI reporting skills in this five-day course. Explore the curriculum and plan your training.
lede: HR analytics training shows HR professionals how to use workforce data to inform people-related decisions. It is designed for HR analysts, HR business partners, people managers, and workforce planners assessing recruitment, turnover, absence, and staffing needs. Learners practise defining metrics, checking data quality, analysing workforce measures, and interpreting Excel and Power BI dashboards, with attention to responsible reporting and human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with HR information, workforce decisions, or people reporting and need to use evidence appropriately.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with HR operations and basic spreadsheet use is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Predictive analytics and AI-assisted HR analysis are covered at conceptual awareness level; spreadsheet calculations and dashboard exercises provide the hands-on application.
